i.norm: Verifies that withWriteTypeIdForDefaultImpl(false) produces a distinct Value: - The returned Value is not equal to EMPTY (which has writeTypeIdForDefaultImpl=null). - The returned Value still has idVisible=false (unchanged from EMPTY). - Equality is not symmetric: neither Value equals the other.
EMPTY has writeTypeIdForDefaultImpl=null; passing false creates a new, distinct instance
idVisible is not affected by withWriteTypeIdForDefaultImpl — it stays false
The two values differ in writeTypeIdForDefaultImpl (null vs false), so they are not equal
